summary: GlobalFoundries Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a Securities Issuance Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce (DOC), dated September 3, 2026. Under the agreement, GF will issue 9,907,399 ordinary shares at $37.85 per share to the DOC. Terms include transfer restrictions prohibiting private sales to competitors, voting restrictions limiting U.S. government voting except on certain class matters or mergers, and customary resale registration rights requiring an F-3 shelf filing within six months. This is a routine capital issuance, not a special situation.
